scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, logo, tagline, and call-to-action buttons prominently as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User arrives at the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that the hero section is immediately visible above the fold
steps.context: Hero section should be the first major content area

steps.description: Confirm MirDB logo, product name, and tagline are displayed
steps.context: Tagline should communicate persistent key-value store with memcached protocol

steps.description: Check for 'Get Started' and 'GitHub' buttons
steps.context: Buttons should be prominently styled and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains MirDB logo, product name, and tagline 'Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' or similar

test_cases.input: Check for 'Get Started' button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Button is visible, clickable, and navigates to quick-start section or documentation

test_cases.input: Check for 'GitHub' button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Button is visible, clickable, and links to MirDB GitHub repository

test_cases.input: Verify hero section is above the fold on desktop (1920x1080)
test_cases.expected: Hero section is fully visible without scrolling

scenarios.name: Key Value Propositions Display
scenarios.description: Verify that key value propositions (memcached compatibility, persistence, performance) are clearly presented as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the key features grid section
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible from hero

steps.description: Check that memcached protocol compatibility is highlighted
steps.context: Should mention compatibility with existing memcached clients

steps.description: Check that data persistence using LSM tree is highlighted
steps.context: Should differentiate from standard memcached

steps.description: Check that performance characteristics are highlighted
steps.context: Should mention Rust implementation and async networking

test_cases.input: Inspect features section for memcached compatibility
test_cases.expected: Feature card/section clearly states memcached protocol support and client compatibility
Feature card/section clearly states data persistence with LSM tree architecture
Feature card/section highlights Rust implementation and Tokio async networking
Features are displayed in a visually appealing grid format with icons or visual indicators

test_cases.input: Check for storage commands in commands section
test_cases.expected: SET, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND commands are listed with descriptions

test_cases.input: Check for retrieval commands in commands section
test_cases.expected: GET and GETS commands are listed with descriptions

test_cases.input: Check for DELETE command in commands section
test_cases.expected: DELETE command is listed with description
INFO and MAJOR_COMPACTION commands are listed and identified as MirDB-specific
